senses.gloss: סַלֵּית (denom. of סִילְּתָא II) to cut chips, trim.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 150b:12">Ib. 150ᵇ</cite> <he>ומְסַלְּתִינָן סילתי</he> Rashi (ed. <he>ומסלתיה</he>, corr. acc.; Ms. M. <he>וסַלְּתִינָן</he>) and we chopped kindling wood.

<cite ref="Beitzah 19b:7">Bets. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>השתא סַלּוּתֵי מסלתינן וכ׳</he> since we are permitted to chop kindling wood (during the festive week), can there be a question about offering &c.? <cite ref="Bava Kamma 113b:11">B. Kam. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>זבין דיקלא</he> … <he>לסַלּוּתֵי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לצלחא</he>) bought a palm-tree … to cut it for fuel.
